about: Wilmot Township is a rural municipality in Waterloo Region, Ontario, west of Kitchener–Waterloo toward New Hamburg, Baden, and New Dundee. Mennonite farm country, villages, and Highway 7/8 corridors define the landscape rather than a single city. It remains one of the region’s more agricultural townships. About 21,000 people live in Wilmot Township.
